paragraph_task: Draft the English manuscript unit 'Introduction and research question' using only the registered evidence and verified literature sources.
editor_instruction: Rewrite the supplied source-bound draft as polished academic English.  Preserve every protected LaTeX block, citation, number, comparison direction, and evidence scope.  Remove defensive writing, stacked hedging, repeated justification, preemptive clarification, imaginary objections, mechanical signposts, repetitive sentence patterns, list-form prose, and uniform paragraph scaffolding. Use coherent paragraphs and keep mean absolute IC attached to factor-expression candidates.
